title: Round 15 / inventor F: m=3 index calculus under the relation-supply criterion
question: Inventor E proved relation supply forces >= 1.22 sqrt p for m=2. For m=3 (S_4) the supply floor is s >= p^{1/3}, so beating rho needs a decomposition finder costing < p^{1/6} per relation on a base of size ~p^{1/3}. Is there a structured base (multiplicative subgroup, image of a low-degree map, isogeny kernel coset) on which the S_4 decomposition is that cheap? Measure finder cost exponents at toy sizes.
rationale: Exact quantitative gap left open by inventors D and E.
success_criteria: Exact statements; reproducible evidence; honest negatives.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursion; no commits.
